diagnoses.analysis: The aggregate status job exits 1 because its required build/test dependencies failed; it needs no workflow change. The underlying PR-attributable failures are repaired in the candidate commits.
evidence: Process completed with exit code 1.

diagnoses.analysis: Vaadin compilation calls hasKind on raw SpanData inside anySatisfy and passes an AssertJ-captured List<? extends SpanData> to a List<SpanData> parameter. Wrap each raw span with assertThat and accept the covariant read-only span list, including the same latent raw-span call in Vaadin16Test. The PR removed the global controller-telemetry opt-in but the shared filter tests still unconditionally required a controller span. Gate only controller-span assertions while preserving framework-provided HTTP routes and server spans. The HTTP test harness also derives server exception-event expectations from handler-span presence, although JAX-RS converts resource exceptions into HTTP responses before they reach the server. Explicitly disable that derived expectation in the shared JAX-RS HTTP fixture for both profiles.
evidence: error: cannot find symbol
error: incompatible types: List<CAP#1> cannot be converted to List<SpanData>
Expected size: 2 but was: 1 in:
java.lang.AssertionError: [Span 0] Expected span [GET /resteasy-context/exception] to have an exception event but only had events <[]>

proposal.body:
Collect JAX-RS and Vaadin telemetry separately for the default controller-disabled profile and `otel.instrumentation.common.controller-telemetry.enabled=true`. Label JAX-RS experimental profiles with both enabled settings, while retaining enabled and disabled behavior coverage.

Controller-only split of #20552 for #20546, based on #20564.
